description: Bar, line, area and donut charts in plain SVG and CSS, no charting library: bars grow from the baseline one after another, lines draw themselves, rings sweep round, and every change of data tweens on a spring. The tooltip glides with rolling numbers, the legend folds series away, and the arrow keys walk the points.
moves: Bars grow from the baseline one after another, left to right; a ring's slices sweep round from the top, and the others fade back from the slice under the pointer.
Lines draw themselves from the left, with their area unrolling under them, and their dots pop in after.
New data, stacking or hidden series tween every bar, line, slice, tick and grid line to its new place, with a small overshoot.
The cursor band or hairline, the tooltip and each line's dot travel to the active point, and the tooltip swings to the other side near the edge.
The tooltip's values, the axis ticks and a donut's total roll to each new number.
A series switched off in the legend folds into its baseline while the others widen into its room.
Legend items sink a little and pop back.
keyboard: Moves focus to the legend's toggles, then to the chart's points as one tab stop.
Moves to the next point and shows its values (Down for horizontal bars).
Moves to the previous point (Up for horizontal bars).
Hides the tooltip; any arrow brings it back.
Switches the focused legend series off or on.

propDocs.Chart.data: The rows. Each has its category under `categoryKey` and a number under each series' key.
propDocs.Chart.config: The series by key, shaped like shadcn's `ChartConfig`: `{ revenue: { label, color?, icon? } }`. Config order is stack and legend order; a series without a colour takes the next of `--chart-1` … `--chart-5`. For a pie or donut, label each slice by its category here too.
propDocs.Chart.categoryKey: The key that names each row: the category for bars, lines and areas, the slice for a ring. Add it to the config with a `label` to name it in the data table.
propDocs.Chart.stacked: Stacks bars or areas on one another instead of side by side.
propDocs.Chart.orientation: For bars: "vertical" (standing, the default) or "horizontal" (lying, categories down the side).
propDocs.Chart.curve: For lines and areas: "smooth" (the default, never overshooting a point) or "linear".
propDocs.Chart.dots: Shows a dot on every point of a line or area, not only on the active one.
propDocs.Chart.categoryGap: The share of each category left empty between bar groups, 0 to 0.9. Defaults to 0.3.
propDocs.Chart.innerRadius: The donut's hole as a share of its radius, 0 to 0.9. Defaults to 0.6 for a donut, 0 for a pie.
propDocs.Chart.padAngle: Degrees of space between slices. Defaults to 1.5.
propDocs.Chart.formatValue: Formats a value for the tooltip, the point names and the data table: `(value, seriesKey) => string`.
propDocs.Chart.formatTick: Formats a value on the value axis. Defaults to compact numbers, like 12k.
propDocs.Chart.formatCategory: Formats a category on the category axis, like `(month) => month.slice(0, 3)`. The tooltip keeps the full name.
propDocs.Chart.activeIndex: The row that is active (hovered, focused or pressed), controlled. `null` for none.
propDocs.Chart.defaultActiveIndex: The row active at first, when you don't control it.
propDocs.Chart.onActiveIndexChange: Runs when the active row changes, with details.reason "item-hover", "item-press", "list-navigation", "focus-in", "focus-out", "escape-key" or "pointer-leave".
propDocs.Chart.hiddenSeries: The series keys (slice categories for a ring) that are hidden, controlled. The last one shown can't be hidden.
propDocs.Chart.defaultHiddenSeries: The series hidden at first, when you don't control them.
propDocs.Chart.onHiddenSeriesChange: Runs when a legend item is pressed, with the next list of hidden keys.
propDocs.Chart.speed: How fast the chart moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
propDocs.ChartTooltip.indicator: The swatch beside each value: "dot" (the default), "line" or "dashed".
propDocs.ChartTooltip.hideLabel: Leaves out the category at the top of the tooltip.

cssVars: The series palette, --chart-1 to --chart-5 in config order (theme tokens a preset sets)
The chart's height, legend and axes included
Grid rules (75% on all but the zero line)
The band or hairline on the active point
Space between bars in a group (never more than a third of a bar)
